sources.entry: Gifted - Turn any short video into an animated GIF quickly and easily.

summary.one_liner: Gifted is a macOS app that converts short videos into animated GIFs.
summary.what_it_does: Gifted takes a short video file and turns it into an animated GIF. The README describes it as quick and easy to use. Its stated purpose is making simple looping animations that can be shared in a chat room or a blog post. The README links to a free download from the Mac App Store. The README is brief and does not list detailed features, settings, or supported formats.
use_cases: convert a short video into a GIF
make a looping animation for a chat room
create a GIF for a blog post
turn a screen recording clip into an animated GIF
how_to_run: Download Gifted for free from the Mac App Store
notable: Free to download from the Mac App Store
Simple video-to-GIF conversion for looping animations
Aimed at sharing in chat rooms and blog posts
caveats: Mac-only; the README names only macOS and the Mac App Store
README gives few details on features, formats, or limits
